title: RRB Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 560 Paramedical Staff Posts
description: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill 560 Paramedical Staff Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in B.Sc Nursing can grab this chance and apply for the RRB Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
